record.body:
## Rationale

The spike already ships a milestone-grouped Phases block that matches the user's ask (scan the roadmap by milestone). Porting it reuses a known layout and avoids inventing a second navigation model while the flat stepper is still the right fallback when there are no milestones.

## Counter-argument

A hybrid (milestone picker + stepper for one milestone) would stay denser and closer to today's chips. That was rejected because the user wants to see phases grouped for scanning, not hide other milestones behind a dropdown.

payload.alternatives: Hybrid milestone picker plus stepper; Nested tree in the effort rail
payload.choice: Port the spike Phases block: milestone headers with phase rows; flat stepper only when there are no milestones
